description: This source file implements nl80211 core functionalities for a Linux-based wireless driver interface, including socket management, event handling, request tracking, and command sending with support for asynchronous and synchronous operations.

classes.name: nlRequest_t
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous netlink request, tracking its state, handler, and timeout.

classes.name: wld_nl80211_state_t
classes.description: Represents the state of an nl80211 socket manager, including socket, request list, counters, and listeners.

methods.name: s_learnDriverIDs
methods.description: Resolves nl80211 family and multicast group IDs for driver communication.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getDriverIds
methods.description: Returns the current nl80211 driver IDs.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getSharedState
methods.description: Returns the singleton shared nl80211 state, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_newState
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new nl80211 state object, including socket setup.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with a nl80211 state.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getStateCounters
methods.description: Retrieves counters for a specific nl80211 state.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getAllCounters
methods.description: Aggregates counters from all nl80211 states.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmd
methods.description: Creates and sends a nl80211 command, supporting both sync and async modes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdSync
methods.description: Sends a synchronous nl80211 command and waits for completion.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_addNlAttrs
methods.description: Adds a list of netlink attributes to a message, supporting nested attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdSyncWithAck
methods.description: Sends a command synchronously and waits for acknowledgment.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdAsyncWithAck
methods.description: Sends a command asynchronously and waits for acknowledgment.
